later_status: Uninspected later historical data; not a live prospective trial
refit: Every 7 local delivery days; same dates for ridge, LightGBM and PatchTST
calibration: Nonnegative CQR expansion from previous 60 delivery days, excluding D-1; finite-sample 80th percentile of pointwise max(lower-y,y-upper,0)
lear: Hourly price-only LEAR: D-1,D-2,D-3,D-7 hourly curves, 7 weekday dummies, invariant scaling, AIC-selected LASSO per hour; daily refit
evaluation: Do not retune after later-data errors are inspected; include all complete days available in requested range
